The closest match is POLO, a partially observable multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for dispatching optimization in multi-platform instant delivery systems, where couriers are not exclusive to one platform and each platform only observes its own orders and courier interactions due to privacy and operational constraints [2]. It learns dispatch policies from platform-local observations and is designed to work with incomplete courier information [2].

If you mean a broader delivery-routing setting rather than multiple apps/platforms, other papers focus on ride-sharing dispatch with many drivers [1], last-mile pickup dispatch and routing [7], or multi-vehicle pickup-delivery [3], but they do not specifically frame the problem as multiple apps with partial visibility into all driver data [1, 3, 7].
